name: Baikonur Site 31/6
best_known_for: Active Soyuz crewed pad — every ISS Soyuz crew rotation since 2020 has lifted from Site 31
credit: Second active Soyuz pad at Baikonur Cosmodrome. R-7 era from 1961; modernised for Soyuz-2.1a in 2014. Took over the Soyuz crew programme from Site 1/5 in 2020. Every Soyuz MS crew rotation to the ISS since MS-16 has lifted from here. Coordinates from Roscosmos and FAI records.
